master_comparison.notes_zh: 每格先列成功率及可用标准差，再列累计优化Token（百万）。P-L：Life-Harness论文适配对照；P-S：SkillOpt论文评测；P*：原文划分；P2：进化集峰值pass@2；M：本地测量；H：历史释放产物；F：共同冻结WebShop环境；Q：待适配或资源。不同分组保留各自协议。
master_comparison.notes_en: Cells give success and available SD, then cumulative optimizer tokens in millions. P-L: Life-Harness adaptation; P-S: SkillOpt evaluation; P*: original split; P2: adaptation-set peak pass@2; M: local measurement; H: historical release; F: common frozen WebShop environment; Q: pending adapter/resources. Each group retains its protocol.

papers.provenance: Life-Harness comparison rows follow its v3 report. SkillFM* follows its original paper and task split. Per-method source identities are retained; these literature rows are separate from local evaluations.
protocol_notes: Meta-Harness, AHE and Life-Harness use six evolution rounds and the same training batches within the paper, with GPT-5.5 as evolution model. Our campaign budgets and optimizers differ.
ALIGN and AgentSquare are released final harness evaluations on ALFWorld and WebShop. ALIGN uses its released task split; AgentSquare uses the Life-Harness task selection.
Paper AgentBench uses one evaluation per task. Our released scores average three. Telecom simulator/access/auxiliary-call conditions differ.
Table 1 values and evolution-token totals are rounded; Table 10/11 values retain their published precision. Null means not reported here, never zero.
SkillFM* uses its original task split and auxiliary skill generator; a same-executor literature reference with distinct data and compute. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.39382

paper_evolution.note_en: Round scores use changing training batches, not held-out tests. Meta-Harness/AHE are reproductions by the Life-Harness authors.

related.name: SkillOpt
related.reason_zh: 官方ALFWorld主结果的做题模型与测试划分不同；作为方法参照，不混入Qwen3-4B榜单。
related.reason_en: Different actor and ALFWorld test split; a method reference, not a Qwen3-4B leaderboard row.

related.name: Meta-Harness
related.reason_zh: 五场景可比数值引用Life-Harness的同做题模型适配结果，非原作者原始成绩。
related.reason_en: Five-benchmark numbers are Life-Harness adaptations, not the original authors’ measurements.

related.name: AHE
related.reason_zh: 主榜引用Life-Harness的同做题模型适配结果；原论文任务不同。
related.reason_en: Main-board values use Life-Harness adaptations with the same actor; the original paper uses other tasks.

related.name: SkillOpt-Lite / HarnessOpt
related.reason_zh: 完整Harness修改已有相关工作；未找到可直接并列的同协议五场景结果。
related.reason_en: Related work already edits full harnesses; no directly aligned five-benchmark row is asserted.

related.name: GEPA
related.reason_zh: 参考反思与互补候选搜索；不把不同任务和模型的分数硬填进主榜。
related.reason_en: A reflection and candidate-search reference; unrelated tasks/models are not forced into the main board.

related.name: Harness-Delta Attribution
related.reason_zh: 区分过拟合、推理开销扩大与可泛化收益；ALFWorld模型、任务划分不同，不并入主榜。其模型缩放主要改变做题模型，我们的对照改变优化模型。
related.reason_en: Separates overfitting, test-time scaling and generalizable gains. Different ALFWorld actors/splits; excluded from the main board. Its scaling changes executors, whereas our optimizer comparison changes improvers.

related.name: OPRO
related.reason_zh: 提示的黑盒优化；用已有解与成绩形成下一步候选。
related.reason_en: Black-box prompt optimization using previous solutions and scores.

related.name: TextGrad
related.reason_zh: 通过文本反馈优化复合系统变量，可包含代码；反馈图提供优化组织。
related.reason_en: Textual feedback over compound-system variables, including code.

related.name: ACE
related.reason_zh: 以生成、反思、整理维护增量经验上下文。
related.reason_en: Incrementally maintained strategy contexts through generation, reflection and curation.

related.name: ADAS
related.reason_zh: 代码空间中的Agent设计与搜索。
related.reason_en: Agent design and search in code space.

related.name: AFlow
related.reason_zh: 工作流节点、算子与连接的搜索。
related.reason_en: Search over workflow operators and connections.

related.name: AutoHarness
related.reason_zh: 合成游戏动作约束或代码策略；任务范围与本榜不同。
related.reason_en: Synthesized game-action constraints and code policies; different benchmark scope.

related.name: HARBOR
related.reason_zh: 给定Harness配置空间中的成本感知搜索。
related.reason_en: Cost-aware optimization over a given harness configuration space.

related.name: Self-Harness
related.reason_zh: 执行Agent自修改运行框架；更新主体与外部优化器不同。
related.reason_en: Agents editing their own runtime harness; a different adaptation actor.

related.name: Continual Harness
related.reason_zh: 持续交互中的在线提示、技能、记忆更新。
related.reason_en: Online prompt, skill and memory updates during continuous interaction.

related.name: HarnessOpt-Bench
related.reason_zh: 将优化模型、起点与固定评测预算纳入统一比较。
related.reason_en: Common study of optimizers, seed harnesses and evaluation budgets.

related.name: SkillFM
related.reason_zh: 任务条件化技能生成；主榜保留其原文划分标记。
related.reason_en: Task-conditioned skill generation; original split identified in the board.

telecom_history.note_en: Versioned paper reports, not our reruns. Qwen3-4B row, not the 18-model average. Score changes alone do not establish why the result changed. Our simulator and runtime-access protocol differ.
telecom_history.note_zh: 论文版本报告值，不是本地复测；使用 Qwen3-4B 单模型行，不混用 18 模型均值。不能仅凭分数变化推断修改原因。我们的用户模拟器和运行接口不同。

queue.policy: High points only, as confirmed by user. Promoted development high points in near-reference groups. Low points stay unmeasured, not scheduled. Current L4 reproduction groups wait for final selection and screening. No test feedback to optimizers.

comparison_catalog.scope: Explicit user request: evaluate comparable published methods. Pending adapter/bundle states are not running jobs or measured results.

methods.name: Life-Harness
methods.reason_zh: 五场景公开内置产物三遍完成；四场景保留有效历史记录，WebShop为新测。仍未认证为论文最终进化包。
methods.reason_en: Three repeats complete on all five benchmarks: four retained valid measurements and new WebShop measurements. Not certified as paper-final bundles.

methods.name: ALIGN
methods.reason_zh: 公开ReAct接口在共同工具调用环境完成ALFWorld109题×3、WebShop200题×3；属于新适配实测。
methods.reason_en: Released ReAct interfaces measured on ALFWorld109×3 and WebShop200×3 in the shared tool-call runtime.

methods.name: AgentSquare
methods.reason_zh: 已有ALFWorld/WebShop模块代码；推荐组合涉及OpenAI嵌入检索与跨任务记忆，接入共同评测前需明确这些额外资源和测试期记忆规则。
methods.reason_en: Public modular policies exist; the recommended combination uses embedding retrieval and cross-task memory, requiring explicit resource and evaluation-memory alignment.

methods.name: Meta-Harness
methods.reason_zh: Life提供原生搜索入口，但未定位与其表格成绩绑定的最终包；从头搜索与产物复测分开排期。
methods.reason_en: Life supplies native search entrypoints; a score-bound final bundle has not been located.

methods.name: AHE
methods.reason_zh: 已有Life原生适配入口；最终产物缺失时需要实际重新搜索，不能把空Harness当论文产物。
methods.reason_en: Life supplies native adaptation. Missing final bundles require an actual new search, not empty policies.

methods.name: HarnessX
methods.reason_zh: 原结果不同模型、pass@2、同任务进化峰值；当前公开树未定位论文场景的最终产物与完整适配。
methods.reason_en: Different actors, pass@2 peaks on adaptation tasks; final benchmark bundles/adapters not located.

methods.name: SkillOpt
methods.reason_zh: 需论文对应Skill与执行Harness；已有SkillOpt风格本地实验不能冒充原作者复现。
methods.reason_en: Requires paper-matched skills and executor harness; local SkillOpt-inspired runs are not original reproductions.

methods.name: SkillFM
methods.reason_zh: 原作者明确未发布模型权重，仅提供代码、配置与训练技能库。完整复现需额外训练资源，不以检索替代生成方法。
methods.reason_en: No model weights released; complete reproduction needs codec/flow training, not a retrieval substitution.

methods.name: Reflexion
methods.reason_zh: 多次尝试与反馈是方法的一部分；必须报告first-attempt及额外尝试成本，不能冒充冻结单遍。
methods.reason_en: Repeated attempts/feedback are part of the method; separate first-attempt and additional-attempt cost.

methods.name: ReflAct
methods.reason_zh: 原论文指令与两条附录示例已接入共同ALFWorld环境；109题×3，Qwen3-4B，单题50次模型调用上限；不是原论文模型成绩。
methods.reason_en: Original instructions and two appendix demonstrations run on shared ALFWorld109×3 with Qwen3-4B and50 model calls; cross-executor prompt transfer.

methods.name: AutoManual
methods.reason_zh: 冻结原作者释放的手册、六类技能与Planner测试流程，在共同ALFWorld109题×3复测。原文WebArena不是WebShop。
methods.reason_en: Frozen released manual, six task-type skills and original planner on shared ALFWorld109×3. Original WebArena is not WebShop.

methods.name: GEPA
methods.reason_zh: 通用优化方法；本场景需原生适配与真实搜索，不直接转抄其他任务结果。
methods.reason_en: A general optimizer; these tasks require a native adapter and actual optimization.

methods.name: HarnessOpt
methods.reason_zh: 作为完整Harness搜索参照；确认共享场景与冻结权重协议后才入主榜。
methods.reason_en: Full-harness search reference; benchmark overlap and frozen-weight protocol still require verification.

methods.name: ReAct
methods.reason_zh: 与ReflAct采用相同两条任务示例与ALFWorld题单，比较Thought和Reflection策略；冻结提示，无测试反馈。
methods.reason_en: Matched two demonstrations and shared ALFWorld tasks compare thought versus reflection; frozen prompts with no test feedback.

methods.name: AdaPlanner
methods.reason_zh: 从既有方法引用链发现；已核实ALFWorld重合，下一批适配原始代码规划与反馈机制。
methods.reason_en: Discovered through prior-work references; ALFWorld overlap verified, code-planning/feedback adapter pending.

methods.name: ExpeL
methods.surface: training experience, extracted insights and retrieval
methods.reason_zh: 从AutoManual与SkillFM引用链发现；核实原作者代码覆盖ALFWorld/WebShop。需对齐训练经验、规则提取和评测时检索。
methods.reason_en: Discovered through AutoManual and SkillFM references; official code covers ALFWorld/WebShop. Training experience, insight extraction and inference retrieval need alignment.

methods.name: Harness-R1
methods.reason_zh: 已启动原作者释放补丁的DBBench共同300题三遍评测，固定Qwen3-4B；不重新训练9B编辑模型。
methods.reason_en: Released engineer patch available; DBBench shared-Qwen3-4B transfer evaluation running.

methods.name: GEPA-Curator
methods.reason_zh: 优化任务筛选与成功经验检索；原文使用gpt-oss-120b执行模型。所查原文未定位Curator专用释放代码；τ-bench不是τ²-Telecom。
methods.reason_en: Task curation and success retrieval for prompt optimization; original actor gpt-oss-120b, no directly matching Qwen3-4B artifact located.

methods.name: Verify-Backtrack Loop
methods.reason_zh: 无需训练的目标栈、双层验证与回退机制；ALFWorld重合，所查原文未定位官方代码，适配待做。
methods.reason_en: Training-free goal-stack verification and backtracking; no official code URL located in the inspected paper.

methods.name: Repairs for Whom?
methods.reason_zh: 评估器与执行器不一致的修复选择研究；用于方法讨论，不是最终Harness主榜成绩。
methods.reason_en: Repair-evaluator/executor mismatch study; cite selection methodology, not a final harness leaderboard row.
